description: Angular component for a status widget in the Thingsboard UI, managing visual state, styles, and resize behavior.

classes.name: StatusWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending BasicActionWidgetComponent, implementing a status indicator with dynamic styling and resize handling.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes settings, registers label patterns, creates value getters, and subscribes to loading state.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets style on content element, initializes resize observer, and triggers initial resize.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Disconnects resize observer on component destruction.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Sets border radius style and triggers change detection.

methods.name: onState
methods.description: Updates widget style based on boolean state.

methods.name: onDisabled
methods.description: Updates widget style based on disabled state.

methods.name: updateDisabledState
methods.description: Sets disabled state and updates style accordingly.

methods.name: onResize
methods.description: Calculates scale and size for responsive design based on container size.

methods.name: updateStyle
methods.description: Updates visual styles based on current state and disabled status.
